answer: Mechanism: geographic latency triangulation. Each epoch, 5 beacon-picked verifier nodes ping every ID; round-trip times place it within ~300 km. IDs whose latency fingerprints match within 4 ms across 3 epochs are flagged as one host. Like a nectar trail leading bees home, the timing traces the source; like saffron it is costly to fake, since 100 fakes need 100 distinct regional servers (~$5 each, $500/month). Reaching the summit of trust takes 12 clean epochs.
